_comment: JEG-96 operating-model phase tracker. State is derived from lanes/linear_fixture.json at read time; this file describes structure only and is hand-maintained for phases/tickets/criteria. To refresh ticket statuses, re-export from Linear and replace lanes/linear_fixture.json (see lanes/PLAN.md).

phases.name: Guards first
entry_criteria: tracker exists and a Lane can answer 'what phase are we in' from it
exit_criteria: every standing check listed in lanes/linear_fixture.json for the JEG-78..84 + JEG-77 tickets is in status Done or Verified
JEG-77 (end-to-end source fidelity) has at least one green run recorded in fixtures/

phases.name: Remove the taps (merge charter + queue)
entry_criteria: docs/merge-charter.md committed with three tiers and exact gates
lanes/merge_charter.py encodes the tier rules and queue
exit_criteria: a Tier-0 pilot PR auto-merges end-to-end with the tier posted as a comment
a Tier-2 pilot PR is held for Jeremy's tap with the reason stated
Jeremy approves the tier definitions (one-time decision replacing per-PR taps)
merge queue proven: serial merges with rebase + re-verify per item

phases.name: Remove the hunting (acceptance + cross-model review)
entry_criteria: phase-1 merge charter in place (cross-model review wired into Tier 1/2 path)
exit_criteria: every Linear issue carries runnable acceptance criteria
lane PRs attach evidence bundles; Roman rejects done-claims without the bundle
cross-model review wired into the merge path

phases.name: Remove the courier and the detector
entry_criteria: phase-0 exit criteria met (JEG-77 monitor is the detector)
JEG-71 (CBS ROS pull/save) and JEG-55 (ESN snapshot to Supabase) shipped
exit_criteria: JEG-77 monitor is green so nobody screenshots the live page
pulls run in CI (no scheduled owner) — CBS, ESPN, Razzball all in workflow
JEG-94 outbox/inbox protocol + Codex CLI device-auth: Roman can fan out codex exec tasks in parallel
Linear comments remain the wake-up signal; the protocol is the lane channel
no claude/chatgpt lane adapters built (Muse-only proven — see PLAN.md 'Out of scope today')

phases.name: Remove the parking (decision queue + digest)
exit_criteria: the four known parked items converted to decision issues with recommendations + deadlines
the first deadline passes with a recorded proceed-or-veto outcome
morning digest is fail-closed on monitor staleness (BH-8 / GAP-039)

hands_off_routine: data refreshes that follow the same methodology and run fresh data through the pipeline to the published chart

out_of_scope_today: claude lane adapter (Codex CLI never verified working; not reachable from Muse)
chatgpt lane adapter (codex account out of usage; not reachable from Muse)
full API-key lane identity machinery (cheap signed-result-files only; graduate to API keys only if cheap version is ever gamed)

tier_definitions._comment: Encoded as checkable rules in lanes/merge_charter.py. Tier classification is the lane's responsibility up front, with Roman re-classifying on review.

gates: diff is mechanically checkable (no binary blobs, no large generated bundles)

trigger_conditions: PR touches dist/, supabase/, sql/, data/
PR touches the fixed-pie or indexation logic
PR changes pricing math or DDL

merge_queue._comment: Encoded as checkable rules in lanes/merge_charter.py. Jeremy 2026-10-02 scope addition: merge queue serializes merges to main with rebase + re-verify per item, eliminating collision cancellations.
per_item: post the tier as a PR comment
merge_queue.rationale: 5 of the 20 most recent Deploy dashboard runs on 2026-10-02 were cancelled by newer pushes; WIP limits alone only reduce collisions, the queue eliminates them.
